top: Before she died, this teacher asked for one thing at her funeral instead of flowers.
comment: Backpacks full of school supplies for kids in need. Tammy Waddell taught in Forsyth County, Georgia, for 30 years, and the pews filled with backpacks 🎒
topic_it: Tammy Waddell, insegnante per 30 anni a Forsyth County (Georgia), morta nel giugno 2018: al funerale chiede zaini con il materiale scolastico invece dei fiori
photo_it: Tammy Waddell + le panche della chiesa piene di zaini (FOX 5 Atlanta)
title: She didn't want flowers at her funeral #kindness #inspiration #teacher
description:
Teacher Tammy Waddell asked for backpacks full of school supplies for kids in need instead of flowers at her funeral, and the pews filled up with them.
